title: Add the jobs array to bee herding status and run the orphan sweep in status and occupancy
action: (1) `bee herding status` (herding.rs:749): before printing, call mailbox::mark_orphans(bee_dir, &live_panes) using the same live pane set occupancy already computes (wave.rs:992 live_pane_ids — make it pub(super) or move the small helper so both verbs share it; when the transport cannot list panes, skip the sweep and say so in one line). Print one line per marked id: `herding: marked job <id> interrupted (process_restarted)`. Then add a `jobs` array to the JSON output and one plain line per job: `job_id`, `pane_id`, `round`, `mark` (from read_mark, null when none), `mark_reason`, `status` — the D2 word computed with the same rule as hcc-6 (stale activity + Alive → stalled; transition_status gives recovered once; else the existing word; a job with a result file shows its result status). Prefix every plain line with the job id so `stalled` never shares a line with herdr's prompt-stall word (plan Open Question 5). (2) `bee herding occupancy` (wave.rs:966): call mark_orphans with its live_panes before computing counts; print the same one line per marked id. Nothing relaunched (D7). Tests with the fake cockpit: status lists a job with mark null, an orphan job gets marked and listed with mark interrupted / reason process_restarted, occupancy sweep marks the same shape.

truths: status output carries a jobs array with job_id, pane_id, round, mark, mark_reason, status
status and occupancy both run the orphan sweep before their output and print one line per marked job
the sweep never touches a job with a result file or a live pane
